Technical specifications · Rev 0.1 · 02 Nov 2026

Used Lubricating Oil

01 / RAW MATERIAL · REV 0.1 | 02 NOV 2026

Incoming used engine, gear, hydraulic and industrial oils for re-refining.

DOCUMENT RRL-QC-UO-001

A. Preferred commercial / operating screen

TEST PARAMETERPROPOSED REROL ACCEPTANCETEST METHOD
AppearanceOil phase; no visible foreign objects or free solvent layerVisual inspection
Water content, % v/vPreferred ≤2.0; 2.0-5.0: review & price adjustmentASTM D95
Pentane insolubles, % m/mPreferred ≤2.0; above this: technical reviewASTM D893
Flash point, PMC, °CPreferred ≥65; low-flash loads: quarantine & assessASTM D93
Kinematic viscosity @ 40 °CReport; 20-200 mm²/s indicative onlyASTM D445
Density @ 15 °CReport, kg/m3ASTM D4052
Total acid number, mg KOH/gReport; preferred ≤5.0ASTM D664
Total halogens / chlorineReport; screen for chlorinated solvent contaminationAccredited lab
Sulphur, % m/mReport for yield and product planningASTM D4294

B. Statutory contaminant screen - Schedule V Part A

CONTAMINANTMAXIMUM PERMISSIBLELAB METHOD
Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs)<2 mg/kg (ppm)Validated GC method
Lead (Pb)≤100 mg/kgValidated metals method
Arsenic (As)≤5 mg/kgValidated metals method
Cadmium + Chromium + Nickel≤500 mg/kg combinedValidated metals method
Polyaromatic hydrocarbons (PAH)≤6%Accredited PAH assay

RECEIVING RULE Hold and investigate any load suspected to contain petrol, chlorinated solvents, antifreeze/glycol, transformer oil or unknown chemicals. Accept only within authorised waste categories and approved receiving procedures.

CLASSIFICATION Commercial limits in Section A are proposed Rerol targets, not limits in Schedule V. Schedule V values in Section B are the cited regulatory screening limits; verify current amendments and permit conditions.

REFERENCE BASIS Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules, 2016 - Schedule V Part A; Rerol internal QC testing template.

Collection process

Four steps from stored oil to documented pickup.

Used oil condition and contamination affect recovery and commercial value, so every enquiry starts with the essentials.

Tell us the volume

Share oil type, approximate quantity, storage method and pickup location.

Test a sample

Density, viscosity, water, sediment and other relevant properties are reviewed.

Plan collection

Pickup date, vehicle, containers and site coordination are confirmed.

Document the movement

The applicable collection and transport records are provided for the transaction.
